answer: Anti-sybil design: force each identity through a sequential puzzle keyed to its address that cannot be batch-parallelized across clones. Wall-clock cost scales linearly with fake count, unlike a shared prism hash farm (1 puzzle ~ 30s per identity). Skipping or outsourcing voids the epoch answer; only completed puzzles unlock karst attestation eligibility and slow-growing summit standing across 6 epochs.
